description: This file is a Node.js script written in TypeScript, intended to analyze other source files for usage of temporary directory functions, specifically os.tmpdir() or tmpdir(), in a software project. It imports utility libraries, defines functions to parse source files, identify specific function calls, and runs as a script to perform these checks.

methods.name: collectOsTmpdirImports
methods.description: Analyzes a TypeScript source file to find import declarations related to 'os' or 'node:os', collecting namespace or default imports and specific named imports such as 'tmpdir'.

methods.name: findMessagingTmpdirCallLines
methods.description: Parses source code to identify calls to 'tmpdir' functions from the 'os' module or variables named 'tmpdir' that are used to access temporary directory paths.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that runs the call site guard analysis to detect usage of os.tmpdir() or tmpdir() in messaging-related source files.
